note: Canonical club identity for RPL. The site reads this through src/lib/teams.ts; the graphics and availability skills read it directly instead of keeping their own hand-copied lists. Add or rename a club HERE and nothing else needs editing.
accentNote: Accents were validated with the dataviz skill's categorical-colour method against the site's panel background (#14110a), as ADJACENT PAIRS IN THIS ARRAY ORDER. Keep the order, keep colour paired with the club name, and never let colour be the only identifier. Blue and orange are deliberately absent - the design system reserves them as in-game side colours. Season 1 clubs have no accent on purpose: they are a historical record, not one of the current identities.
